mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,vendor_id,status FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT phone FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{user}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_privacy_numbers SET status='idle',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE virtual_number IN (SELECT virtual_number FROM t_privacy_bindings WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status='active' AND expire_at <= NOW(3))
UPDATE t_privacy_bindings SET status='released',released_at=NOW(3),release_reason='expired' WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status='active' AND expire_at <= NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id,virtual_number,expire_at FROM t_privacy_bindings WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status='active' AND expire_at>NOW(3) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT virtual_number FROM t_privacy_numbers WHERE status='idle' AND pool_code <> 'demo_pool' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_privacy_numbers SET status='occupied',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE virtual_number=#{number} AND status='idle'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notifications(id,user_id,order_id,kind,title,body) VALUES(#{id},#{user},#{order},'privacy_call_invite','对方正通过平台隐私号联系你','对方通过平台虚拟号码联系你；真实号码不会对另一方显示。')
